entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I can't believe they pushed someone[n]with a record on me. A male teacher[n]would be better suited for this...
entries.uk: Не віриться, що на мене повісили когось[n]із судимістю. Учитель-чоловік[n]тут підійшов би краще...

entries.speaker: PE Teacher
entries.en: Why in the world was someone like that[n]admitted here?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Who knows? It was the principal's[n]decision.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I was told that it's for the school's[n]reputation.
entries.uk: Мені сказали, що це заради репутації[n]школи.

entries.speaker: PE Teacher
entries.en: I would've thought that my volleyball[n]team has contributed more than enough[n]to cover that.
entries.uk: А я гадав, що моя волейбольна[n]команда й так зробила для неї[n]більш ніж достатньо.

entries.speaker: PE Teacher
entries.en: Then again, if anything were to happen,[n]I'd kick out a student like that right away.
entries.uk: Хоча, якщо щось станеться, я б[n]такого учня одразу вигнав.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I keep wishing that he'd just end up[n]not coming to school.
entries.uk: Я все сподіваюся, що він просто[n]не ходитиме до школи.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Still, that isn't something I should be[n]saying as a teacher...

entries.speaker: PE Teacher
entries.en: Well, I should be returning to practice.
entries.uk: Що ж, мені пора повертатися на тренування.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, right. The tournament's coming up,[n]isn't it?

entries.speaker: PE Teacher
entries.en: Hehe, having such high expectations[n]placed on you by others is quite a[n]problem in itself.
entries.uk: Хе-хе, коли від тебе стільки[n]очікують, це саме по собі[n]неабияка проблема.

entries.speaker: PE Teacher
entries.en: We'll have to work hard to make up[n]for the track team too.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Why'd it have to be my class?
